Hi Andrie, Thanks very much for your help. I wasn't sure if it was possible, but it is. 

In fortify() for lm objects I can easily use the below code to get mpg_, with the original data and the diagnostics data in one data frame. 
data(mpg)
mpgmod <- lm(cty ~ displ, data = mpg)
mpg_ <- data.frame(mpg,fortify(mpgmod)[,-c(1:2)]) # where mpg_ has original data and all diagnostics


I want to generate mpg_ with a lme object in the same way. Using the built in data set Orthodont, say we have 
fm2 <- lme(distance ~ age + Sex, data = Orthodont, random = ~ 1)

How can we then generate a data frame like mpg_ using fortify()?

Thanks! Scott
